requirements: Use the route delivery context for units, data losses, inspection, runtime scope and recovery.
A declared operation is not a claim of native qualification; consult scoped source-bound receipts.

material.purpose: Define a Principled BSDF surface material for declared meshes.

cube.purpose: Create a cubic mesh with a material, scalar side length and centre.

bevel.purpose: Round mesh edges with bounded width and segment count.

readGltf.purpose: Import one mesh from a self-contained glTF 2.0 JSON document; external resources are unsupported.

lathe.purpose: Revolve a radius/height profile into a mesh; choose segments and end caps explicitly.

grid.purpose: Create a subdivided rectangular mesh for surface modelling.

polylineTube.purpose: Sweep a circular tube along explicit points.

curveFromCSV.purpose: Build a tube from named finite numeric CSV coordinate columns.

uvSphere.purpose: Create a sphere tessellated by latitude and longitude.

icoSphere.purpose: Create a sphere from subdivided icosahedral triangles.

cone.purpose: Create a tapered cone or frustum.

torus.purpose: Create a ring mesh with independent major/minor radii and tessellation.

weld.purpose: Merge nearby mesh vertices within an explicit distance tolerance.

weightedNormal.purpose: Reweight shading normals; this does not repair topology.

voxelRemesh.purpose: Reconstruct geometry at a selected voxel size; fine features and topology can change.

bend.purpose: Bend a mesh around a selected axis.

twist.purpose: Twist a mesh around a selected axis.

shrinkwrap.purpose: Project the input mesh toward a separately declared target mesh.

wireframe.purpose: Turn polygon edges into solid struts with explicit thickness.

solidify.purpose: Give a surface thickness with an explicit offset.

subdivision.purpose: Subdivide a mesh using the selected native subdivision method.

decimate.purpose: Reduce polygon count with an explicit target ratio; geometric detail can be lost.

smooth.purpose: Relax mesh vertex positions for a bounded number of iterations.

array.purpose: Repeat a mesh with relative offsets.

mirror.purpose: Reflect a mesh across selected axes with optional seam merging.

boolean.purpose: Combine input and operand meshes with an explicit Boolean operation; valid inputs are required.

assignMaterial.purpose: Assign a declared material to a mesh.

applyTransform.purpose: Bake object transforms into mesh geometry.

shadeSmooth.purpose: Choose smooth or flat polygon shading; topology is unchanged.

join.purpose: Join declared mesh objects into one mesh without a Boolean union.

readSTL.purpose: Import triangle geometry from STL with explicit scale; source units are not inferred.

readPLY.purpose: Import PLY mesh geometry with explicit scale.

transform.purpose: Translate, rotate and scale a mesh using declared object transforms.
